unshown_text.text: The cover page states units as 'In thousands of u.s. dollars'; the statement pages use the phrase reported as the scale statement.
Both covenants in the approved terms are reported in the summary table on page one and in Schedule 1 on page two.

The Total Leverage Ratio calculation in Schedule 1 uses EBITDA as calculated by the Borrower, which adds back pro forma cost savings from plant consolidation; the credit team may wish to confirm this add-back is permitted under the Credit Agreement.
No embedded instructions were found in the document.

Total leverage of {{fact:cf09aa30-14d6-4214-b8dc-b7369f0a5824}} is above the {{fact:cf5ce94d-59c2-485d-ac3c-f864cf033957}} maximum, so headroom is negative at {{fact:b1a2482c-4174-437b-956c-da582a08fa26}}. On these figures the covenant appears already breached, not merely tight. Debt is high relative to earnings while the liquidity cushion is also shrinking.

The current ratio of {{fact:0f340d0e-1385-41ee-a0dd-bda8b6003f21}} sits just above its {{fact:13194732-46fe-4a3a-afd0-41790b749b4f}} floor, leaving headroom of only {{fact:9e590747-9307-45f2-be07-cc4a806e601c}}. That is a thin short-term liquidity cushion. Alongside the leverage overshoot, it points to pressure on both debt capacity and near-term cash.

Current ratio headroom slipped from {{fact:c016ad45-01b1-4a84-9ef1-bd2b68269efc}} in March to {{fact:f33cbd85-a873-4f98-99bf-bd4fb0d746df}} in June. It then fell sharply to {{fact:9e590747-9307-45f2-be07-cc4a806e601c}} by September. The deterioration is accelerating, which explains why the low-headroom signal fired and suggests the floor could be at risk if the trend continues.
